# Flash write guard

Resets the camera on a flash write outside the allowed data windows.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x600c4680` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Normal operation may write only to three data windows; block 0, the boot area and the other components are written by updates.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Allowed windows and the reset path read from the flash writer. Source: [E-M5 III recovery (technical notes)](../sources/em5n.recovery.md).
